Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 29 Sep 2003 05:44:11 -0700, ns...@hotmail.com (Nicx) scrawled:

>Hi,
>
> I check on previous answers on the newsgroup but i want to make
>sure :)
>
> 1- Vampire A rush Vamp B. Vamp A play a earth meld or a Majesty and
>then Psyche! Does he stay untap or the Psyche cancel the effect of the
>combat end/untap?

Majesty card text: "...As above, and this vampire untaps before combat
ends."
Psyche (superior) is played just after the combat ends, even though it
is a combat card.
Suffice to say you stay untapped if you untapped with Majesty/Earth
Meld, and then Psyche is played.

> 2- Does a Psyche cancel the 1 damage from a catatonic fear?

Yes it does cancel the damage.

From 01-may-2002
"Effects that end combat and then do something else after combat (all
in the single resolution of the effect) will fizzle if combat doesn't
end or if a new combat is started....Note that this doesn't apply to
end combat and untap effects - the untap effect is not delayed to
after combat..."
